shift_length_h: length of the working shift, hours
flow_velocity_m_s: mean flow velocity in the test section, m/s
ambient_temperature_c: ambient temperature at the site, degrees Celsius
pipe_diameter_mm: inner diameter of the pipe, mm
coolant_flow_gal_min: coolant flow, US gallons per minute
dust_concentration_mg_m3: airborne dust concentration, mg per cubic metre
kinematic_viscosity_cst: kinematic viscosity of the fluid, cSt
sensor_age_months: age of the installed sensor, months
operator_shift: shift during which the record was taken
